# ghost/messages

Google Messages without an account: save an SMS draft (never sends), list conversations, read a conversation.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/messages
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/messages draft_message --device <serial> --param number=<number> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/messages list_conversations --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/messages read_conversation --device <serial> --param number=<number>
```

## Actions

- `draft_message`: Draft a text to 555 0100 saying See you at 6, but don't send it
- `list_conversations`: Show my text message conversations
- `read_conversation`: Read my texts with 555 0100
